name: CompounderFinance
fix_description: Add access control to deposit() — only the vault or controller should be able to call it. Also add slippage protection (non-zero min_mint_amount) in the add_liquidity call to prevent sandwich attacks.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, interactions across several yield tokens and a Curve pool, plus protocol-specific understanding of how StrategyDAICurve.deposit can be abused after manipulating pool balances. While the PoC is not extremely long, it requires understanding nontrivial cross-contract state changes and sequencing beyond a simple bug pattern.
